sources.name: Gemeente Terschelling — Agenda
sources.selectorHint: SPA (Next.js + Drupal); requires headless browser — no static selectors
sources.notes: Next.js SPA over Drupal 'SIMsite' backend. /agenda returns ~1 sentence server-side; all events load client-side. No public API found (/api/* all 404). Sitemap at /sitemap.xml confirms /agenda path. Municipality explicitly lists all island events here.

sources.name: VVV Terschelling — Evenementen
sources.selectorHint: SPA (Next.js); requires headless browser — no static selectors
sources.notes: Most comprehensive Terschelling-specific event calendar. Next.js SPA; server returns address/phone only. Hreflang: /nl/evenementen/, /de/veranstaltungen/, /en/events/. Sitemap confirms village pages for West-Terschelling, West aan Zee, Hee, Horp, Kaard, Kinnum, Baaiduinen, Striep, Midsland, Midsland Noord. No /api/events endpoint. Actively maintained — shows 'Kunst te Kijk 15 oktober 2026'.

sources.name: Wadden.nl — Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: Simple server HTML; no event calendar (links out to vvvterschelling.nl)
sources.notes: Portal/gateway site. No independent event calendar — links to VVV Terschelling for events. Low independent scraping value.

sources.name: Friesland.nl — Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: .article-card or .event-listing (Plaece CMS standard pattern)
sources.notes: Custom 'Plaece' CMS (assets.plaece.nl). Server-rendered HTML. Province-level tourist site covering all Friesland. Also has /nl/uitgelicht/festivals overview page which lists Oerol, Springtij etc. Search at /nl/zoeken?query=X.

sources.name: Friesland.nl — Festivals overzicht
sources.selectorHint: .festival-card (Plaece CMS)
sources.notes: Province-wide festival overview page; includes Oerol and Springtij among Friesland festivals. Subset of friesland.nl content.

sources.name: Oerol Festival
sources.selectorHint: WordPress standard: .entry-title, .entry-content, .wp-post-image; programme loads via Algolia JS
sources.notes: WordPress CMS (Yoast SEO, custom theme pms72-oerol). Algolia search for programme. Queue-it.net for ticket queue. RSS /feed/ confirmed live but EMPTY off-season (no <item> elements — only populated during festival season ~June). Tickets at tickets.oerol.nl redirects to login. Annual island-wide performing arts festival. hasJsonLd likely (WordPress+Yoast generates Article schema) but Event-specific JSON-LD not confirmed.

sources.name: Springtij Forum
sources.selectorHint: Wix Thunderbolt SPA — no static selectors; all content client-side only
sources.notes: Wix Thunderbolt SPA (isSEO:false, siteRevision:2). Completely client-side rendered. /programma returns 404 server-side. Annual sustainability/policy forum (~September). Requires full JS execution to access programme.

sources.name: Weekblad De Terschellinger
sources.selectorHint: WordPress: .entry-title, .entry-date, .entry-content (paywall blocks full body)
sources.notes: WordPress (Yoast SEO v7.1). RSS /feed/ confirmed working with recent articles. Content behind member paywall — RSS metadata accessible, article bodies require subscription. Sitemap at /sitemap_index.xml. Transitioning to 'Pubble' publishing system. Island's main weekly newspaper. blocked:true refers to paywalled content, not bot-blocking.

sources.name: Omrop Fryslân — Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: Custom CMS; article list likely .article-item or .nieuws-item
sources.notes: Frisian regional public broadcaster. Page confirmed live. Returns minimal server-side content. Primarily news articles tagged Terschelling, not a structured event calendar. Low structured-data value.

sources.name: Leeuwarder Courant — Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: BLOCKED — HTTP 403 on all fetches
sources.notes: Regional newspaper covering Friesland including Terschelling. HTTP 403 Forbidden on all automated requests. Paywall on most content. Not scrapable without authentication.

sources.name: Wrakkenmuseum Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: BLOCKED — HTTP 403 on all paths including root
sources.notes: Museum of shipwrecks in West-Terschelling. Domain exists on hosting but returns 403 on root, /agenda, and all sub-paths. Cannot confirm if it has an events page.

sources.name: Staatsbosbeheer — Terschelling activiteiten
sources.selectorHint: Activity cards loaded via /Assets/js/activity.min.js; JSON fields: {title, date, location, type, url}
sources.notes: Server HTML skeleton + client-side JS loads activities. JSON API at /api/activities exists and returns data but DOES NOT filter by location server-side — returns all national activities. Client-side filter forced: {location:'Terschelling',locationtype:'natuurgebied'}. Date param: datum. Type param values: Activities/Walking/Accomodations. Manages Boschplaat nature reserve (east Terschelling).

sources.name: MooiWeer Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: Server HTML; menu structure: ul.menu-activiteiten li a; calendar content in main section
sources.notes: Organization JSON-LD confirmed: {@type:Organization, address:{addressRegion:'West-Terschelling'}} — NOT Event-specific. Server-rendered PHP/static CMS. GTM-TBGPJN3. /activiteiten/kalender = 'Wat is er vandaag te doen?' daily calendar. /zomerprogramma = summer programme. Activities: blokarten, GPS tours, paintball, RIB zeehonden, wadkanoën, SUP, yoga (Hee duinmeer), archery tag, powerkiten, wadlopen, golfsurfen, boogschieten, mountainbiken, brandingkanoën, beachgolf. Also runs MooiWeer Café and Speeltuin.

sources.name: Rederij Doeksen
sources.selectorHint: Nuxt.js (Vue 3) SPA — requires headless browser
sources.notes: Ferry operator Harlingen↔Terschelling. Nuxt.js SPA. /terschelling confirmed with destination info. /dienstregeling for timetable (SPA widget). No event calendar — primarily ferry schedules. /agenda returns 404. Limited event scraping value.

sources.name: TrailRun Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: Static server HTML; event details in <main> or <body> text
sources.notes: Custom PHP CMS. Annual trail run event. 11th edition: February 28 2027. Distances: 10/15/25 km through dunes, forest, beach. Registration at /inschrijven.php. Linked from MooiWeer navigation. Formerly trailrunterschelling.nl redirects to apex domain.

sources.name: HT Race — Harlingen–Terschelling Zeezeilrace
sources.selectorHint: Joomla CMS: .blog-entry .entry-header, .article-info, article h2
sources.notes: Joomla CMS with YooTheme template. Annual sailing race from Harlingen to Terschelling. 2026 edition: May 28–29, 2026. Full event schedule in server-rendered Joomla article structure. Finish at West-Terschelling harbour. Municipality has dedicated pages for parking restrictions during HT Race.

sources.name: Camping De Kooi — Activiteiten
sources.selectorHint: Server HTML; programme likely in .programma or table element
sources.notes: Active camping between Midsland and West-Terschelling. Summer activities: buikglijden, huttenbouwen, SUP, BBQ, live music (De Mannen van Hee). Summer programme at /activiteiten/programma/ (redirects to 2023 page — needs updating check). References MooiWeer for additional bookable activities.

sources.name: Europarcs Resort Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: SPA — server returns empty body; requires headless browser
sources.notes: Holiday park on Terschelling. Page exists (europarcs.nl/nl/parken/resort-terschelling) but returns empty server-side content (SPA). Activity programme likely exists but not accessible without JavaScript.

sources.name: Café De Vuurtoren
sources.selectorHint: One.com Website Builder static HTML; no events section found
sources.notes: Café in West-Terschelling. One.com Website Builder (custom HTML/CSS). Active domain. No events calendar (/agenda → 404, /evenementen → 404). Brochure-only site.

sources.name: De Mannen van Hee
sources.selectorHint: Simple custom site; no structured events section
sources.notes: Local Terschelling band ('De Mannen van Hee'). Active since 2005. Performs annually at various island locations. Site states: 'Elke zomer treden we op verschillende plekken op het eiland op.' No machine-readable events page (/optredens, /agenda, /concerten all → 404).

sources.name: Festivalinfo.nl — Terschelling/Friesland filter
sources.selectorHint: Server HTML skeleton + JS-loaded festival cards; likely .festival-item or .festival-card
sources.notes: planetnine.com CMS. RSS feed confirmed working (national scope — all Dutch festivals). Partner sites: podiuminfo.nl, cabaretinfo.nl, agendainfo.nl. The festival list may be JS-loaded even from the filtered URL. RSS is the most reliable feed but requires filtering by location name post-fetch.

sources.name: Uitagenda.nl
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA (Laravel backend); no static selectors
sources.notes: Laravel + Vue SPA. JSON-LD on homepage: {@type:WebPage} — not Event-specific. Focused on dance, live music, theater. No Terschelling-specific city page confirmed (/terschelling-west, /terschelling, /zoeken?q=terschelling all → 404). May list Oerol and large Terschelling events incidentally.

sources.name: Weeztix (formerly Eventix)
sources.selectorHint: SPA — search returns homepage testimonials, not a structured results page
sources.notes: Eventix rebranded to Weeztix. Generic Dutch ticketing platform. Search URL does not render filterable results server-side. No Terschelling-specific event landing page confirmed. Oerol historically used Paylogic (now part of Weeztix ecosystem) + queue-it.net virtual queue.

sources.name: Eventbrite
sources.selectorHint: BLOCKED — HTTP 405 on all search endpoints
sources.notes: HTTP 405 on all search/event endpoints. Actively blocks non-browser requests. International ticket platform — may list some Terschelling events but not scrapable.

sources.name: Ticketswap
sources.selectorHint: BLOCKED — Cloudflare bot protection (HTTP 403)
sources.notes: Secondary ticket resale market. Cloudflare bot protection active. Not scrapable. Would list Oerol and other ticketed Terschelling events.

sources.name: Gemeente Terschelling — Bestuurlijk Informatiesysteem
sources.selectorHint: Council meeting system; /Agenda returns HTTP 500 (system bug, not block)
sources.notes: Municipal council meeting publication system (iBabs or similar). Root confirmed live. /Agenda returns HTTP 500 — server-side bug. Contains raadsvergaderingen and commissie meetings — NOT public cultural events. Included for completeness (official public meetings of municipality).

sources.name: Terschelling Langetermijnagenda (Gemeente)
sources.selectorHint: table.onderwerptabel > tr.onderwerp-titels; pagination at div.digg_pagination; week view: /set_periode?view_type=week; quarter: /set_periode?view_type=kwartaal
sources.notes: ⚠️ NOT a public events calendar — this is the gemeente's GOVERNANCE long-term agenda (beleidsstukken, kredietaanvragen, verordeningen). Ruby on Rails app. Public read-only, login required to post. Contains items like 'Burgerinitiatief opstellen verordening', 'Kredietaanvraag fietsstraat Duinweg Midsland-Formerum'. Has 4 pages of items. Color categories: kleur1-kleur7. Server-rendered HTML. Useful only for tracking official municipal dossiers, not cultural events.

sources.name: Café De Vijfpoort — Programma
sources.selectorHint: WordPress The Events Calendar; REST API returns full JSON event objects with title, start_date, end_date, description, url, image
sources.notes: Muziekcafé in Formerum 47, 8894 KB Terschelling. WordPress v7.1 with The Events Calendar plugin. REST API CONFIRMED WORKING with real events: 'THE BÖSSELS+DJ JAN VAN TEAKE' (June 11, 2026, Oerol dag 0), recurring 'ZATERDAGAVOND' (Saturdays 21:00), recurring 'DANSAVOND!' (Wednesdays in summer). API supports start_date/end_date/per_page query params. iCal feed link in HTML head: /wp/events/?ical=1 (returned empty content on direct fetch — may need Accept header). RSS at /wp/feed/ confirmed. Open year-round on Saturdays; Wednesdays+Saturdays in July/August. Known Oerol music programme venue (VPRO 3voor12 coverage).

sources.name: Dún Restaurant Terschelling — Event List
sources.selectorHint: Wix Thunderbolt SPA (isSEO:false, siteRevision:59) — no static selectors; requires headless browser
sources.notes: High-end restaurant in the dunes by chefs Richard van Oostenbrugge and Thomas Groot. 'Geïnspireerd door de woeste waddennatuur' — local produce (Waddenzee fish/cockles, cranberries, dune rose hip, local cheeses). Full Wix Thunderbolt SPA — /event-list is a Wix events page. Accessible page URL confirmed but all content requires JavaScript. No server-rendered event data.

sources.name: Feestcafé De Schotse Vier — Events
sources.selectorHint: Laravel + Alpine.js; /agenda redirects 301 to /events; JSON-LD BarOrPub confirmed; event cards likely in main content section (server-rendered Blade template)
sources.notes: Feestcafé at Oosterburen 13, 8891 GA Midsland. Known as the main nightlife venue in Midsland. JSON-LD confirmed: {'@type':'BarOrPub','name':'Schotse Vier','address':{'addressLocality':'Midsland','addressRegion':'Terschelling'}}. Also WebPage JSON-LD. Phone: +31562448538. Open daily 16:00–02:00. DJ nights (Kevin, Martijn, Thomas), Nederlandstalige meezingers, 80s/90s, après-ski. Events page description: 'automatisch bijgewerkt' (automatically updated). /agenda redirects 301 to /events. Has Merchandise and 'Kroeg afhuren' pages. Uitagenda listing at /locaties/feestcafe-de-schotse-vier. Also references uitagenda.nl/midsland for event overview.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — West-Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA; events partially server-rendered (first items visible in HTML); event cards in .evenement-card or similar
sources.notes: Village-specific uitagenda page confirmed live (200 OK). Title: 'Uitagenda van West-Terschelling'. JSON-LD: {'@type':'WebPage'}. Shows events at venues in West-Terschelling. Part of uitagenda.nl's Laravel+Vue platform. Some events appear to be server-rendered in the HTML body.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — Formerum (Terschelling)
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA; -terschelling suffix disambiguates from other Dutch Formera
sources.notes: Village-specific uitagenda page confirmed live (200 OK). Title: 'Uitagenda van Formerum - Terschelling'. Includes events at Café De Vijfpoort. Note: /formerum (without -terschelling suffix) returns 404 — must use suffix.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — Hoorn (Terschelling)
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA; -terschelling suffix REQUIRED — /hoorn (bare) returns Hoorn Noord-Holland
sources.notes: Village-specific uitagenda page confirmed live (200 OK). Title: 'Uitagenda van Hoorn - Terschelling'. ⚠️ CRITICAL: /hoorn (without suffix) returns Hoorn Noord-Holland (Museum van de Twintigste Eeuw) — always use /hoorn-terschelling.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — Oosterend (Terschelling)
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA; -terschelling suffix required; /oosterend (bare) returns 404
sources.notes: Village-specific uitagenda page confirmed live (200 OK). Title: 'Uitagenda van Oosterend Terschelling'. Easternmost village of Terschelling. /oosterend (bare) returns 404.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — Midsland
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA; event cards partially server-rendered; confirmed event: 'Flügel Summer Night' at Feestcafé De Schotse Vier (Di 01/09)
sources.notes: Confirmed live (200 OK) and confirmed Terschelling Midsland — shows 'Flügel Summer Night' at De Schotse Vier (Oosterburen 13, 8891 GA, Terschelling). Note: /midsland-terschelling returns 404; bare /midsland works. The page title says 'Uitagenda van Midsland' — also serves Midsland in other Dutch provinces, but Terschelling venues (Schotse Vier) appear here confirmed.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — Lies
sources.selectorHint: Vue.js SPA; page exists but Terschelling-specificity unverified
sources.notes: ⚠️ UNVERIFIED for Terschelling — page confirmed live (200 OK), title 'Uitagenda van Lies'. 'Lies' is a small village on Terschelling (between Hoorn and Midsland). However, this could also serve other Dutch localities named Lies. No events visible server-side to confirm Terschelling content. Check before relying on this source.

sources.name: uitagenda.nl — Feestcafé De Schotse Vier (venue page)
sources.selectorHint: Server-rendered venue profile page; events listed below venue info section
sources.notes: Venue profile page confirmed live with server-rendered content. Shows address (Oosterburen 13, 8891 GA Midsland), phone (0562 448 538), links to schotsevier.nl, Facebook, Instagram. Description of venue with events info. The page itself serves as the uitagenda listing for this specific Midsland venue. Venue URL pattern: /locaties/{slug}.

sources.name: Berenloop Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: BLOCKED — HTTP 403 on all fetch attempts
sources.notes: ⚠️ BLOCKED — HTTP 403 Forbidden. Site confirmed to exist (consistent 403, not DNS error). Correct domain is berenloopterschelling.nl — NOT berenloop.nl (which DNS-fails). Annual trail run/marathon across Terschelling island. 2026 edition: November 1–2, 2026. Distances: 42.2km (November 2), 21.1km (November 2), 10km and 5km 'Kleintje Marathon' (November 1). Confirmed via Stayokay Terschelling arrangements page which links directly to berenloopterschelling.nl.

sources.name: Camping Terpstra
sources.selectorHint: WordPress (Rank Math SEO); no events/agenda page found (/agenda → 404, /evenementen → 404)
sources.notes: Youth camping ('jongerencamping') at Midslander Hoofdweg 27, 8891GG Midsland, Terschelling. WordPress with Rank Math SEO. Schema.org Place + Organization JSON-LD confirmed. Phone: +31-562-449-091. Social: Facebook, YouTube, Instagram (@campingterpstra). Activities page at /over-camping-terpstra/activiteiten/ describes nightlife proximity (Midsland cafés). No events calendar page found. Campsite is close to De Schotse Vier café.

sources.name: Stayokay Terschelling
sources.selectorHint: Server-rendered CMS; arrangement cards in main content
sources.notes: Youth hostel on Terschelling. Arrangementen page confirmed with event-linked packages: Berenloop (November 2026, links to berenloopterschelling.nl), Oerol mentioned. No dedicated calendar page. /activiteiten redirects to /nl/tips/terschelling/all-topics (Terschelling tips by topic: Cultuur, Actief, Eten & Drinken, Kidsproof, Duurzaam winkelen). Low direct event-scraping value but confirms key island events.

sources.name: Puur Terschelling — Activiteiten
sources.selectorHint: Server-rendered CMS (/nl/ prefix); activities listed as separate pages under /nl/activiteiten/
sources.notes: Family-run horse and sheep farm with agro-touristic activities. Paardrijden (horse riding on Friese paarden and Shires), huifkartocht, mennen, wadlopen. Multi-day arrangements including rides to Boschplaat and Drenkelingenhuisje. Target: east end of island (Oosterend area). /nl/agenda/ returns 404 — no events calendar. Arrangements are bookable packages, not dated events. paardrijdenterschelling.nl redirects here.

sources.name: Camping Appelhof
sources.selectorHint: BLOCKED — HTTP 403 on all fetch attempts
sources.notes: ⚠️ BLOCKED — HTTP 403 on both campingappelhof.nl and www.campingappelhof.nl. Site confirmed to exist (consistent 403). Popular camping near Formerum/Midsland, often mentioned alongside De Vijfpoort café. Cannot confirm if site has an events/activities programme.

sources.name: Natuurmonumenten — Agenda
sources.selectorHint: Server skeleton + JavaScript loading ('Loading...' placeholders); API likely behind auth
sources.notes: National nature conservation organisation with Terschelling activities (boswachter excursies, vogelexcursies, Wilde Buitendagen for children). /agenda returns server HTML skeleton with 'Loading...' placeholders — all activity data loaded via JavaScript. API probe: /api/activities?location=terschelling returned a login page ('Gebruikersnaam of e-mailadres') — API is behind authentication. Search param ?q=terschelling appears on the URL but events still load client-side. Requires headless browser for event scraping.

sources.name: Vijfpoort.nl — iCal Feed
sources.selectorHint: iCal/ICS feed — standard VCALENDAR/VEVENT format
sources.notes: iCal feed URL discovered in HTML <head> of vijfpoort.nl as <link rel='alternate' type='text/calendar'>. Direct fetch returned empty content (no events in response body) — may require specific headers or browser context. The REST JSON API (/wp/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events) is more reliable than the iCal feed. Listed here as a separate entry because the iCal format may be useful for direct calendar integration if it activates correctly. Note: this is the SAME venue as 'Café De Vijfpoort' entry above — duplicate source for different feed type.

sources.name: Terschelling.nl — 'Alle evenementen' article
sources.selectorHint: SPA (Next.js/Drupal); article content minimal server-side
sources.notes: Municipality press release/article confirming that terschelling.nl now lists 'alle evenementen op Terschelling'. Article text: 'Er gebeurt van alles op Terschelling; bewonersavonden, symposia, informatieavonden, spreekuren, maar ook festivals, en andere evenementen. Het houdt het eiland levendig!' This confirms the /agenda page (batch 1) is intentionally the central event calendar. No additional technical data — same SPA limitations as /agenda. Listed as explicit confirmation of the municipality's event aggregation mandate.

sources.name: VVV Terschelling — Excursies
sources.selectorHint: Next.js SPA — returns only address/phone server-side; all content loads client-side
sources.notes: VVV Terschelling excursions listing page. Confirmed as Next.js SPA — server returns only address (Willem Barentszkade 19a, 8881 BC West-Terschelling) and phone (+31 562 443000). All excursion listings (zeehondenexcursie, wadlopen, etc.) load client-side. Sitemap confirms /excursies/ path. Complements /evenementen/ with bookable excursions. Individual excursion pages (e.g. /excursies/zeehondenexcursie/) return 404 — slug structure may differ.

sources.name: VVV Terschelling — Nieuws
sources.selectorHint: Next.js SPA (same platform as /evenementen/)
sources.notes: VVV Terschelling news section confirmed in sitemap (lastmod 2026-05-13). May contain event announcements. Same Next.js SPA limitations as /evenementen/. Sitemap shows this path exists and is indexed.
